exactClaim: Proves the Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers conjectures over every characteristic-zero field. Any homogeneous ideal containing a regular sequence, of arbitrary length and degrees at least two, admits a lex-plus-powers ideal with the same Hilbert function and no smaller graded Betti numbers.
scope: A definition-led reading guide; the exact mathematical claim is preserved separately. This is not a proof assessment.
